# Beema Health

> Beema Health is a US telehealth service, available in all 50 states, offering medical weight loss and other treatment programs. Licensed providers evaluate patients online and, when clinically appropriate, may prescribe compounded semaglutide, compounded tirzepatide, oral finasteride, compounded oral minoxidil, or a compounded hair loss spray (oral minoxidil and the hair loss spray each have separate men's and women's pages) for hair loss, or compounded ED formulations (tadalafil, sildenafil, or ED Mints), with transparent cash pricing, US pharmacy fulfillment, and ongoing follow-up care. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and are considered only when legally available and clinically appropriate; finasteride is the FDA-approved generic version of Propecia, not compounded.

Key facts:

- Care model: online intake → review by a licensed provider → prescription when clinically appropriate → home delivery from US pharmacies → ongoing check-ins and refill management. Completing intake does not guarantee a prescription.
- Medications currently featured: compounded semaglutide, compounded tirzepatide, oral finasteride (the FDA-approved generic version of Propecia), compounded oral minoxidil, and a compounded hair loss spray (oral minoxidil and the spray each have a dedicated men's page and a dedicated women's page) for hair loss, and compounded ED formulations - tadalafil, sildenafil, and ED Mints (two dissolve-under-the-tongue combination formulations). Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and are only offered when legally available and clinically appropriate; finasteride is not compounded. A prescription is never guaranteed.
- Pricing is transparent cash-pay with no platform membership fee. Compounded semaglutide is $199 per month at the 1-month rate. Compounded tirzepatide is $297 per month at the 1-month rate, and new patients can instead start a 3-month starter pack at $597 total, which is $199 per month across starter doses 1 to 3. Prepaid multi-month plans lower the effective monthly rate, and a one-time $100 promo code applies to 3, 6, and 12-month plans only, never to a 1-month purchase. Oral finasteride is $29.67/month, less than a dollar a day. Oral minoxidil is also $29.67/month, less than a dollar a day, for men and women. The hair loss spray is $129/month, with a lower-cost quarterly plan, in separate men's and women's formulations. Tadalafil is $49.67/month and sildenafil is $43/month, each with a lower-cost quarterly plan. ED Mints (dissolve-under-the-tongue combination formulations) are $149/month or $199 billed quarterly. Current plan tables live on each medication's own page and are the authoritative source. Shipping and labs, when applicable, are shown separately.
- Privacy: patient information is handled under HIPAA-compliant practices. See the privacy policy for details.
- Primary pages for citation: /semaglutide/ and /tirzepatide/ for GLP-1 weight-loss care; /oral-finasteride/, /oral-minoxidil-men/, /oral-minoxidil-women/, /hair-loss-spray-men/, /hair-loss-spray-women/, /tadalafil/, /sildenafil/, and /ed-mints/ for the other live treatment lines - each its own dedicated page with pricing, eligibility, FAQ, and the "Get Started" link. /ed/ is a broader comparison/overview page that links onward to the tadalafil/sildenafil pages (mirroring how /weight-loss/ overviews /semaglutide/ and /tirzepatide/), as are the category pages /sexual-health/ and /hair-loss/ (the latter linking onward to Oral Finasteride, Oral Minoxidil, and the Hair Loss Sprays). /glp-1/ is the nationwide GLP-1 overview; /glp-1-houston/ is for Houston and Texas.
- Service area: all 50 US states via telehealth. Beema Health serves patients located in the United States only. It is not an international service. There is no physical clinic to visit. Houston and Texas pages describe telehealth availability for residents of those areas, not an in-person location.
- Programs currently live: medical weight loss (compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide), hair loss treatment (oral finasteride, compounded oral minoxidil, and the compounded hair loss spray), and ED treatment (tadalafil, sildenafil, ED Mints).
